description: React component for rendering a modal suggestion list with dynamic positioning and scroll handling in a Mattermost web application.

classes.name: ModalSuggestionList
classes.description: A React component that displays a suggestion list in a modal, managing its position and visibility based on input and window size.

methods.name: calculateInputRect
methods.description: Calculates the bounding rectangle of the input element.

methods.name: onModalScroll
methods.description: Handles scroll events within the modal to update scroll position state.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listeners after component mounts.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners before component unmounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates position and bounds when component updates.

methods.name: getChildHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the suggestion list content.

methods.name: updateInputBounds
methods.description: Updates the input element bounds in state.

methods.name: updatePosition
methods.description: Determines whether the suggestion list should appear above or below the input based on available space.

methods.name: updateModalBounds
methods.description: Updates the modal container bounds in state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the suggestion list with appropriate positioning.
